## Lecture notes

- **L01** [[RL-L01 - Intro, MDPs & Bandits|Intro, MDPs & Bandits]]  
  *Reinforcement Learning, Multi-Armed Bandit, Markov Decision Process, Value Function, ...*
- **L02** [[RL-L02 - Dynamic Programming|Dynamic Programming]]  
  *Dynamic Programming, Policy Evaluation, Policy Improvement, Policy Iteration, ...*
- **L03** [[RL-L03 - Monte Carlo Methods|Monte Carlo Methods]]  
  *Monte Carlo Methods, First-Visit MC, Every-Visit MC, Monte Carlo Control, ...*
- **L04** [[RL-L04 - Temporal Difference Learning|Temporal Difference Learning]]  
  *Temporal Difference Learning, TD(0), TD Error, SARSA, ...*
- **L05** [[RL-L05 - Tabular to Approximation|Tabular to Approximation]]  
  *Function Approximation, Value Function Approximation, Stochastic Gradient Descent, Semi-Gradient Methods, ...*
- **L06** [[RL-L06 - On-Policy TD with Approximation|On-Policy TD with Approximation]]  
  *Linear Function Approximation, Feature Construction, Tile Coding, Semi-Gradient Methods, ...*
- **L07** [[RL-L07 - Off-Policy RL with Approximation|Off-Policy RL with Approximation]]  
  *Episodic Semi-Gradient Control, Semi-Gradient Methods, On-Policy vs Off-Policy, Deadly Triad, ...*
- **L08** [[RL-L08 - Deep RL Value-Based|Deep RL Value-Based]]  
  *Deep Q-Network (DQN), Experience Replay, Target Network, Conservative Q-Learning (CQL), ...*
- **L09** [[RL-L09 - Policy Gradient Methods|Policy Gradient Methods]]  
  *Policy Gradient Methods, REINFORCE, Policy Gradient Theorem, Baseline, ...*
- **L10** [[RL-L10 - Advanced Policy Search|Advanced Policy Search]]  
  *Policy Gradient Methods, Policy Gradient Theorem, Actor-Critic, Deterministic Policy Gradient, ...*
- **L11** [[RL-L11 - SAC, Decision Transformer & Diffuser|SAC, Decision Transformer & Diffuser]]  
  *Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), Maximum Entropy RL, Decision Transformer, Decision Diffuser, ...*
- **L12** [[RL-L12 - Model-Based RL|Model-Based RL]]  
  *Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, Dyna, Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), AlphaGo Zero, ...*
- **L13** [[RL-L13 - Partial Observability|Partial Observability]]  
  *POMDP, Belief State, Predictive State Representation, Partial Observability, ...*
- **L14** [[RL-L14 - Recap|Recap]]  
  *Reinforcement Learning*
